about: The cloud machine's caches as sha256-pinned packages (pc/pack-caches.mjs). pc/build-caches.mjs installs a package with an archive url (or --from a copied tar) instead of rebuilding that family, so the render PC uses exactly the geometry the shots were reviewed with. code_hash = the identity of the code that makes the family at packing time (pc/build-caches.mjs familyCodeHash).
